modulargolems:metal_golem_template.name: Crafting the golem
modulargolems:metal_golem_template.text:
To craft a golem, use stone cutter to cut metal golem template into required parts. Then use anvil to apply metal ingots onto the parts. Then assemble the parts into a golem holder in crafting table. You can use parts of different materials to get better golems.

To summon golem, right click it on a block. You can retrieve the golem by right clicking it with empty hand. You can fix the damaged golem with ingots matching the body material of the golem in anvil. Each ingot heals 1/4 of the max health. Thus, you can use cheap body material and expensive material for other parts to have high health while make it cheap to fix.

When the golem dies, it will only drop 1 ingot from each part. You can use the Recycle Upgrade to let the golem drop repairable holder on death. You can change golem parts by combining new part with golem holder in crafting table in specific orientation. You will lose the old part in this process but keep everything else.

modulargolems:recycle.name: Upgrading the golem
modulargolems:recycle.text:
To upgrade the golem, craft the upgrades and apply them in anvil. Upgrade can provide modifiers to golems, which adds special abilities or improve stats. Golem can only have limited upgrades, and each modifier has its own max level.

Use grindstone to remove all golem upgrades. Blast golem holder item with explosion to retrieve upgrades. If you have Create installed, you can use deployer to automatically apply upgrades without experience cost.

modulargolems:metal_golem_holder.name: Metal Golem
modulargolems:metal_golem_holder.text:
Metal Golem is similar to vanilla iron golem. Other than being fixed in anvil, it can also be healed directly by using ingots matching body material on the golem directly.

Metal golem can be equipped with special armors using command wand.

modulargolems:humanoid_golem_holder.name: Humanoid Golem
modulargolems:humanoid_golem_holder.text:
Humanoid golem is a player-like golem. It can use armor, meelee weapons, bows, crossbows, trident, and shield. Right click the golem with equipments to equip, and shift-right click the golem to un-equip all. If you shift-right click with empty hand, the golem will be retrieved naked as well. Right click the golem with empty hand to retrieve the golem with equipments stored within. Humanoid golem can perform area attack if and only if it holds a sword-like item.

Humanoid golem can use shield, trident, bow, and crossbow. Use the Skin Button in the Humanoid Golem equipment screen to change its skin.

Supported input formats:

Player Name - Use the Minecraft skin of a player
Resource Path - Use a custom texture from resource packs, e.g.:
modulargolems:textures/iws2000.png
Entity id() - Use texture from vanilla zombie / skeleton / piglin variants, e.g.:
minecraft:drowned

Right-click the button to reset to default skin. If Touhou Little Maid is installed, use the Maid Skin Button in the equipment screen to switch to a maid model.

modulargolems:dog_golem_holder.name: Dog Golem
modulargolems:dog_golem_holder.text:
Dog golem is a wolf-like golem. It runs fast and has high attack. Right click the golem with an item or shift click it to sit it down. Right click the golem with empty hand to retrieve the golem.

You can ride it using Rider Wand, or right click dog with humanoid golem to add passenger. Use Size Upgrade to allow more passengers. Lv.2 Size Upgrade allows a Metal Golem as passenger. Dog golem is relatively cheap to make, but also has low health. 2 parts of the golem have uneven cost and stats.

modulargolems:retrieval_wand.name: Retrieval Wand
modulargolems:retrieval_wand.text:
Right click golems to retrieve golem back into inventory, as if the player right clicks it by empty hand.

Right click to retrieve golems the player points to, up to 64 blocks far.

Shift right click in air to retrieve all golems in a radious of 20 blocks. When L2Backpack is present:

When player has Ender Backpack equipped, golems will be retrieved to ender backpack.

When player has their own dimensional backpack in inventory or ender backpack, golem with respective config color will be retrieved to dimensional backpack.

modulargolems:command_wand.name: Command Wand
modulargolems:command_wand.text:
Shift right click golem to configure equipments, view golem attributes, and configure curios.

Attack entity with this wand, or right click faraway entity with this wand to call all your surrounding golems to attack that entity. Right click to switch between 6 modes for the golems.
Following Mode: the default mode. Golem follows player.
Guarding mode: Golems will wander around the point when it's set to this mode. Golems in this mode cannot change dimension.
Standing Mode: Golems will not move. Golems in this mode cannot change dimension.
Wandering Mode: Golems will wander around freely.
Squad Mode: Golems will follow its captain (with the same config), and when itself is the captain or when no captain is present, it will wander freely.
Patrol Mode: Golems will follow the path specified in its config card. They will deviate from their path if they find attack target.

modulargolems:summon_wand.name: Summon Wand
modulargolems:summon_wand.text:
Right click to summon a golem on target block, from your off hand or inventory.

Shift right click to summon all golems from your inventory around you. When L2Backpack is present:

This wand can also summon golems from Ender Backpack equipped.

If player has their own dimensional backpacks in inventory or ender backpack, this wand can also summon golems with same config color as the dimensional backpack those golems are in.

modulargolems:rider_wand.name: Rider Wand
modulargolems:rider_wand.text: Right click dog golem to ride it. If golem is in water, shift will make golem sink faster. Thus, you cannot use shift to dismount. Instead, you need to right click with rider wand.

modulargolems:squad_wand.name: Squad Wand
modulargolems:squad_wand.text:
Right click golem to set it as captain. Golems must have config card in order to be a captain. Each config card may only have one captain.

When a non-captain golem is set to Squad mode, it will follow the captain of the same config card. Captain should not have be in squad mode, as it needs to lead the team.

modulargolems:white_config_card.name: Config Card
modulargolems:white_config_card.text:
Right click golem to set config. Right click again to remove. When in offhand, wands would only target golems having this config.

Rename the item and right click to set the item name as config name. All card from the same owner and same color are in fact the same config. In config menu, put golem in to set golem to have this config. You can choose the default mode for golem when golems are summoned. And you can set whether golems should spawn at old location or current location when they were retrieved.

Note that golem will only be summoned in previous location if that location is within 64 blocks and golem is not in following mode. You can also lock golem interaction, so that you would not accidentally pick them up, or change their weapons, even when you have the card in offhand. If you lost the card, you can make a new one of the same color to unlock golems.

You can also configure item filters for pickup upgrade. This is helpful to not accidentally pickup unwanted items or destroy valuables. You can configure golem attack targets. The hostile target list contains targets golems will actively attack. The friendly target list containers targets golems will never attack.

There are default cards but you can remove them and insert your own, so that you can use golems to fight other golems or other players. You can configure golem patrol path in config. Craft Patrol Path Recorder and record a circular path by clicking blocks with it.

Blocks have to be less than 16 blocks apart. Longer paths is marked in red and may result in golems teleporting to destination.

The path is for guidance only. Golem will not always step on the exact block.

modulargolems:golem_facade.name: Golem Facade
modulargolems:golem_facade.text:
You can use a Golem Facade to make a golem look like if it's made with another material.

Craft with empty upgrade template and an ingot of desired material in anvil, then put it on golem skin curios slot.

modulargolems:golem_slicing_axe.name: Golem Slicing Axe
modulargolems:golem_slicing_axe.text:
When a metal golem kills other players‘ golems without recycle upgrade with this axe, all parts will be dropped and there is a chance for each of the upgrades to drop.

Edit the target filter in config card to allow golems to attack other golems. Note that golems cannot attack golems you own. When a metal golem kills certain mobs with this axe, one random metal golem part with matching material will drop:
Vanilla: Iron Golem, Warden
Cataclysm: Netherite Monstrosity, Ignis, Harbinger, Maledictus, Scylla, Ancient Remnant
Mowzie's Mobs: Ferrous Wroughtnaut
Legendary Monsters: Ancient Guardian, Cloud Golem

modulargolems:candy_construct.name: Candy
modulargolems:candy_construct.text: Main material to craft Candy golem parts. Shoots candy and cheap to fix. Use JEI (press R) to check part stats of each part made of this material. Use JEI (press R) to check part stats of each part made of this material. Use JEI (press R) to check part stats of each part made of this material.

modulargolems:magnetic_construct.text: Main material to craft Magnetic golem parts. Pull targets in melee mode and push targets in ranged mode. Consume iron to protect itself. create:andesite_alloy.text:
Main material to craft Andesite Alloy golem parts. It is cheap to fix and provides magic damage resistance. Boosts speed and damage when consuming fuels.

Fuels can be automatically consumed from Dimensional Backpack (from L2Backpack) equipped on the golem or the captain of the team. Use JEI (press R) to check part stats of each part made of this material. Use JEI (press R) to check part stats of each part made of this material. Use JEI (press R) to check part stats of each part made of this material.

Fuels can be automatically consumed from Dimensional Backpack (from L2Backpack) equipped on the golem or the captain of the team. Use JEI (press R) to check part stats of each part made of this material. Use JEI (press R) to check part stats of each part made of this material.

Fuels can be automatically consumed from Dimensional Backpack (from L2Backpack) equipped on the golem or the captain of the team. modulargolems:pickup.name: Pickup Upgrade
modulargolems:pickup.text:
Allow golems to pick up items and experiences. The pickup radius increase with upgrade level. Max: 3

There are 2 Augments available, also it supports L2Backpack and Create Enchantment Industry as destination to receive items and experiences.

Note that golem will not actively find items and experiences. The golem will attempt to teleport the item to player. If it's in standing mode, it will first try to put the items into the closest container within 1 blocks. If neither container nor the player is present, it will destroy the item to prevent lag. If the golem has No Destroy Augment, it will not destroy the item. The golem will first try to use the experiences to fix its mending equipments. Then if the golem has Mending Augment, it will try to heal itself with the experiences. Then, if the player is present, it will give the experiences to player. Otherwise, it will destroy the experiences. If you installed L2Backpack, golem can use Dimensional Backpack and will try to insert items into its Dimensional Backpack before searching for containers.

If you installed Create Enchantment Industry, golem will try to insert experiences into the disenchanter if it stands on one, before trying to teleport the items to player.
